???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What is the difference between a latency-optimized and a throughput-optimized design?"

        A latency-optimized design spends its transistors on finishing one chain of dependent work as fast as possible. A throughput-optimized design spends them on running many independent pieces of work at once, so the amount finished per second is high even though no single piece is fast.

        Introduced in [G1. Throughput machines](g1-throughput-machines.md).
